dial.summary: BTC rebounded from $55K weekend lows to $61K on Nov 23 against Extreme Fear sentiment (Fear Index 11), confirming deleveraged market structure; Global M2 holds at $103.9T with an expanding 4-week trend and ISM Manufacturing at 55.5% (10th consecutive expansion) underpin the macro bid — DXY headwind at 103.80 and real yields at 2.88% remain risks, but neutral-to-zero funding rates (0.0024%), BTC.D firm at 57.6%, and improving TOTAL market cap ($2.14T) continue to argue for accumulation ahead of the December 1 ISM print and December 9 FOMC decision.

indicators.name: Global Liquidity (Global M2)
indicators.note: StreetStats 4-economy basket at $103,884B ($103.9T) as of November 20, 2026; September 2026 G4 confirmed data forms the base; US M2 component at $23.41T in September (Macrotrends, +5.7% YoY); 4-week trend UP (3-month basket growing +0.82% at constant exchange rates per StreetStats); status supportive (4-week trend up, no YoY contraction signal); next confirmation when October G4 aggregates publish.

indicators.name: ISM Manufacturing PMI
indicators.note: October 2026 ISM Manufacturing PMI at 55.5% (released November 2), above consensus 54.6%, up from September's 54.5%; 4-week trend UP (Sep 54.5 → Oct 55.5, +1.0pp); Production sub-index at 59, highest since Nov 2021; Prices Paid 75.2 (from 77.9); status supportive (above 50 and rising, 10th consecutive expansion month); November 2026 data not yet released — next release December 1, 2026.

indicators.name: DXY (US Dollar Index)
indicators.note: ICE DXY at 103.80 on November 23, 2026 per DealPlexus (103.76 at 7:40am IST, day range 103.73–103.85); Crypto Briefing reports dollar opened lower at 103.80 after recent 19-month peak near 103.97 on Nov 19; Trading Economics showed 103.807 on Nov 22; 4-week trend UP — from ~101.7 on October 23 to 103.80, net +2.1 points (+2.1%), well above the 0.5% flat threshold (DTWEXBGS broad index FRED correlation confirms direction); status headwind (ICE DXY 103.80 is above 100 threshold).

indicators.name: Real Yields (US10Y - CPI)
indicators.note: 10-year TIPS real yield (DFII10) at ~2.88% as of November 19, 2026 per Watchgold/FRED; StreetStats shows 2.81% Nov 20 close; Macrotrends 2.92% for Nov 16; Nov 19 reopening TIPS auction cleared at 2.903% (highest since 2002); 4-week comparison: Oct 23 estimate ~2.90% (near Oct 5 peak of 2.95%) → Nov 23 ~2.88% = ~-2bps, within flat threshold (<5bps); status neutral (above 2% but flat trend — headwind requires both rising trend AND above 2%).

indicators.name: 2s10s Yield Curve
indicators.note: 2s10s spread at +29bps as of November 20, 2026 (Treasury par-curve tracker Nov 20: 29bp; weekly recap Nov 20: 0.30%; low of 0.24 on Nov 14 then uptick to 0.30 by Nov 19; Nov 10: +25bp; Nov 5: +38bp); 4-week comparison: Oct 23 estimate ~+40bps → Nov 23 ~+29bps = flattened ~11bps over 4 weeks, exceeds the 5bps flat threshold → trend DOWN (flattening); curve remains in steepening territory off the inversion low but losing recent momentum; status neutral (positive spread, not inverted — headwind requires < -50bps).

indicators.name: Fed Balance Sheet
indicators.note: WALCL at $6,741,452M ($6.74T) as of November 18, 2026 per Federal Reserve H.4.1 (Nov 11: $6,758,867M; Nov 4: $6,748,145M; Oct 28: $6,745,635M); 4-week comparison: Oct 28 $6,745,635M → Nov 18 $6,741,452M = -$4.2B = -0.06%, well within flat threshold (<0.5%); next H.4.1 release November 25 or December 2; status supportive (QT effectively paused, balance sheet stable YoY — no aggressive tightening signal).

indicators.name: BTC Funding Rates (perps avg)
indicators.note: CoinGlass OI-weighted BTC funding rate at ~0.0024% per 8h as of November 22, 2026 (CoinGlass BTC page: 0.0024% annualized ~2.63%; futures page: 0.0050%; CryptoNRO average across Binance/Bybit/OKX: +0.0035%); rates were briefly negative on Nov 16 on Binance, OKX, Bybit, Gate, and Bitget; 30-day trend FLAT — oscillating near zero or slightly negative throughout October–November; status supportive (well below 0.04% headwind threshold; BTC recovering from $55K lows to $61K on no sustained negative funding confirms deleveraged organic demand).

indicators.name: Stablecoin Dominance
indicators.note: Stablecoin market cap $280.4B (DefiLlama Nov 22, down from $281.5B Nov 20 and $309.7B May 2026 peak; USDT $174.6B, USDC $68.7B); total crypto market cap ~$2.14T (KuCoin Nov 23, BTC at ~$61K / 57.6% dominance); derived stablecoin dominance ~13.1%, down from 14.1% peak on Nov 20 as BTC recovered +4% from weekend lows; 30-day trend UP — from ~10.7% on October 21 (total market ~$2.6T) to ~13.1%; status neutral (dominance rising on 30-day basis but total market cap falling over same period — headwind requires BOTH rising, not met).

upcoming.title: GDP Q3 2026 — Second Estimate
upcoming.note: BEA releases Q3 2026 GDP second estimate at 8:30 AM ET on the compressed Wednesday pre-Thanksgiving schedule (Nov 26 Thanksgiving); watch consumer spending and PCE deflator revisions for any upside that would reinforce the December 9 FOMC hike case; released same day as October PCE on thin pre-holiday liquidity.

upcoming.title: PCE Inflation / Personal Income (October 2026)
upcoming.note: BEA releases October 2026 Personal Income and Outlays at 8:30 AM ET; PCE is the Fed's preferred inflation gauge — a hot core reading above +0.3% MoM would reinforce the December 9 FOMC hike case after October CPI surprised at +0.4% MoM; this is the last major inflation print before the November 29 FOMC blackout period starts.

upcoming.title: ISM Manufacturing PMI (November 2026)
upcoming.note: ISM releases November 2026 Manufacturing PMI at 10:00 AM ET (first business day of December); October reading was 55.5 (10th consecutive expansion month); a continuation above 55 would reinforce the late-cycle expansion narrative heading into the December 9 FOMC meeting; Prices Paid sub-index closely watched given elevated input cost pressures in October.

upcoming.title: JOLTS Job Openings (October 2026)
upcoming.note: BLS releases October 2026 JOLTS at 10:00 AM ET; a print above 8M openings would reinforce the tight labor market narrative supporting the December 9 hike case; the quits rate is a leading indicator of wage growth; released 3 days before the November NFP (December 4).
